title: Working Out a Late Fee on a ShieldCare Instalment Plan
content:
## The quantity

The fee billed on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan whose premium instalments have run past
grace is defined as follows.

1. **The instalment arrears on the plan** is the premium instalments billed on it less the premium
   payments received against it, taken to the cent and never below nothing.
2. **The unpaid periods** are that arrears divided by the monthly premium of the plan, counted as
   whole periods; a part of a period left over is not counted.
3. **The fee for each unpaid period** is the plan's late fee.
4. **The periods counted toward the fee** are every unpaid period.
5. **The rate at which the fee is billed** is the plain rate of 100 percent, without escalation.
6. **The amount written off the fee** is nothing.
7. **The fee billed** is the fee for each unpaid period multiplied by the periods counted and by
   the rate at which it is billed, less anything written off, taken to the cent and never below
   nothing.

The monthly premium of the plan and the plan's late fee are the figures recorded against that plan.

## Worked through on hypothetical figures

Take a plan whose monthly premium is 10.00 and whose late fee is 7.50. Its premium history carries instalments
billed of 120.00 and premium payments received of 70.00.

| Step | Figure |
| --- | --- |
| instalments billed less payments received, taken to the cent | 50.00 |
| that arrears divided by the monthly premium of 10.00, as whole periods | 5 |
| the fee for each unpaid period | 7.50 |
| the periods counted toward the fee | 5 |
| the rate at which the fee is billed | 100 percent |
| the amount written off | 0.00 |

The fee for each unpaid period, 7.50, multiplied by the 5 periods counted and by the rate of 100 percent, comes
to 37.50. With nothing written off, the fee billed is 37.50.

Had the arrears stood at 55.00 on the same plan, the whole periods would still be 5, because the 5.00 left over
is a part period and is not counted; the fee billed would again be 37.50.
